alignments.note: Rule 17/25: subject pronoun and auxiliary join the finite verb across the fronted adverbial.
Rule 29: no article morpheme in the chain, so the supplied the sits on the construct noun.
Rule 19: of belongs to the nomen rectum.

Rules 2/30/33: ever jointly renders the comprehensive duration of all days; for supplies the temporal accusative relation of that expression. Giving for to kol would assign a duration helper as if it independently rendered the quantifier, while leaving kol unrepresented would discard the totality carried inside ever. Retain the two lexical morphemes fused, headed on the temporal noun and ever; the article contributes no English determination and stands separately unrepresented.
Rules 29/30: for ever writes no determiner realizing the article; a fixed expression does not absorb an article whose sense its English rendering does not carry.
